svg.text: Servo-tilted clear acrylic plate rolls each object off the correct edge into a bin
ISOMETRIC ENGINEERING VIEW · units ≈ cm · grid = 10 cm · orange arrows = object flow · red dashed = sensor beam · translucent = acrylic
→ Drops one object at a time onto the plate
→ Sees an object leave the funnel
→ Tracks position + colour of the object
→ Centre pivot lets plate tilt on 2 axes
→ Link servo horns to plate underside
→ One bin on each side of the plate
→ Holds camera + feeder above the plate
The platform IS the actuator: no belt, arm or gripper. Two servos tilt a clear
plate and the camera closes the loop on the object’s live position, so it can
also steer objects around each other. Cheapest build with the strongest
IR gate under the funnel sees the object drop; it lands on the
Overhead camera + OpenCV give colour, shape and live (x, y)
Class → target edge; a PD loop on the 2 servos computes tilt
Plate tilts, object slides off the chosen edge into its bin,
plate levels for the next one.
